review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–90) and counted uses of localL2Energy elsewhere in the NavierStokesAndEuler directory. It appears in only 3 other files, 10 times in total. The file defines one scalar functional, localL2Energy, plus elementary inequalities: nonnegativity, the bound by the global norm, the 2a+2b triangle-type estimate, the decomposition estimate and a ball bound. A bundled structure here would be optional packaging. The functional is a squared seminorm, so it is not itself a seminorm, and a norm-like bundle would not clearly simplify any existing consumer. Wrapping the energy as the squared norm of an indicator-restricted L² element would be hypothetical and would add coercion overhead. I did not inspect those other files in detail, so there is some uncertainty about them.
